basic_info.description:
Charming 3 bedroom, 1 bath home in Glen Park neighborhood. Upstairs features 2 spacious bedrooms, 1 bathroom with jet tub, updated kitchen with granite counter top and stainless steel appliances, kitchen skylight, bathroom skylight, ceiling fans in upstairs bedrooms and plenty of closet space. Plantation shutters in windows and brand new roof installed 8/15/2025.
Ground floor features 2 car tandem garage, 1 bedroom, 1  bonus room - ideal for media, office or work out room and a spacious covered area perfect for family and friends gathering that leads to a private backyard. Just blocks to Glen Canyon Park's trails, Glen Park Village's charming shops and restaurants, schools, bus lines and few minutes walk to BART/Muni station.
